alchemy/adopt-review.why: Resource takeover needs an explicit migration decision.
alchemy/adopt-review.risk: An agent can silently adopt and overwrite somebody else's infrastructure.
alchemy/adopt-review.deterministic: none; a takeover may be intentional

alchemy/init-config-exposure.why: Deploy-time values can become deployed secrets.
alchemy/init-config-exposure.risk: An agent can upload local deploy credentials into runtime bindings.
alchemy/init-config-exposure.deterministic: partial: alchemy/config-in-init enforces placement, not which secrets runtime needs

alchemy/removal-policy-change.why: Human review belongs on weakened retention.
alchemy/removal-policy-change.risk: An agent can turn a harmless refactor into permanent data deletion.
alchemy/removal-policy-change.deterministic: none; destruction authorization is a human decision

alchemy/removal-policy-review.risk: An agent can accept the provider's destructive default without noticing.
alchemy/removal-policy-review.deterministic: none for resource disposability; invalid Stage-effect shape could become deterministic

alchemy/resource-replacement-review.why: Resource identity changes can replace live data.
alchemy/resource-replacement-review.risk: An agent can rename logical resources without a migration path.
alchemy/resource-replacement-review.deterministic: none; safe replacement depends on deployment intent

alchemy/state-store-change.why: State-store changes require a migration plan.
alchemy/state-store-change.risk: An agent can point planning at empty state and duplicate infrastructure.
alchemy/state-store-change.deterministic: none; the migration cannot be proved from a local call

core/abstraction-earns-keep.why: One human question for abstraction ownership.
core/abstraction-earns-keep.risk: An agent can add forwarding interfaces and layers that hide rather than own decisions.
core/abstraction-earns-keep.deterministic: partial: core/no-reexport-only-modules and effect/no-static-service-forwarders catch narrow shapes

core/boundary-resilience.why: Move timeout and discarded-error syntax to oxlint.
core/boundary-resilience.risk: An agent can leave requests hanging or hide their failures.
core/boundary-resilience.deterministic: partial: shopify-app/require-fetch-abort-signal, effect/require-abort-signal and core/no-discarded-caught-error; generic non-Shopify fetch/client timeout coverage still needs a deterministic rule

core/bounded-data-access.why: Inspect the callee and full fluent chain; skip raw SQL.
core/bounded-data-access.risk: An agent can read an unlimited dataset, but raw SQL commands are not necessarily reads.
core/bounded-data-access.deterministic: none for cardinality; a configured ORM-limit oxlint rule is a future alternative
core/bounded-data-access.diagnosis: heuristic: regex searched nested arguments and multiplied one query into every wrapper; missing exemption: arbitrary SQL commands; fluent limits were invisible

core/bounded-work.why: Cuts fixed-work noise; sampled precision remains 0%.
core/bounded-work.risk: An agent can create unbounded provider load through collection fan-out.
core/bounded-work.deterministic: partial: effect/require-all-concurrency, effect/require-for-each-concurrency and effect/bounded-retry cover Effect shapes, not general cardinality
core/bounded-work.diagnosis: scope: tests; heuristic: any await plus any map, fixed three-call sequences, explicit finite timeouts and enclosing routines all triggered Re-measurement still has 0 true positives, 5 false positives and 3 uncertain samples; keep advisory pending narrower bindings or retirement.

core/change-scatter-review.why: Prefer named invariant surfaces to repeated tokens.
core/change-scatter-review.risk: An agent can duplicate one policy across files instead of centralizing its ownership.
core/change-scatter-review.deterministic: none; repeated words do not prove duplicate policy

core/comment-signal.why: Keep deterministic dead-comment checks; drop prose nits.
core/comment-signal.risk: An agent can add comments that obscure constraints with narration.
core/comment-signal.deterministic: partial: core/no-dead-comments; signature/narration quality remains deliberately unautomated

core/correlated-optional-state.why: Review illegal state combinations in domain types.
core/correlated-optional-state.risk: An agent can encode impossible status/payload combinations as optional fields.
core/correlated-optional-state.deterministic: none; independent optional fields may be valid

core/expected-value-recomputed.why: One independent-oracle review; arithmetic alone is weak.
core/expected-value-recomputed.risk: An agent can repeat a production bug in its expected-value calculation.
core/expected-value-recomputed.deterministic: none; inverse and reference algorithms are valid independent oracles

core/fake-parity.why: Stateful fakes need real contract evidence.
core/fake-parity.risk: An agent can test a fake that agrees with itself but differs from production.
core/fake-parity.deterministic: partial: core/no-stubbed-subject catches mocking the subject, not fake/real parity

core/fallback-masks-failure.why: Gate swallowed errors; use schemas for required inputs.
core/fallback-masks-failure.risk: An agent can turn failed reads or required missing data into successful empty results.
core/fallback-masks-failure.deterministic: partial: core/no-discarded-caught-error, effect/no-swallowed-failure and tanstack-query/no-swallowed-query-fn-error; legitimate domain defaults cannot be rejected by names/counts

core/flag-forked-function.why: Intent and decomposition are one architectural review.
core/flag-forked-function.risk: An agent can combine unrelated operations behind boolean switches.
core/flag-forked-function.deterministic: none; a runtime flag may describe real domain data

core/hotspot-change-review.risk: An agent can repeat defects on historically sensitive surfaces.
core/hotspot-change-review.deterministic: none; repository evidence determines which paths matter

core/integration-test-owns-its-boundary.why: Check the claimed integration boundary, not all doubles.
core/integration-test-owns-its-boundary.risk: An agent can call a mock-heavy unit test an integration test.
core/integration-test-owns-its-boundary.deterministic: partial: core/no-vitest-mocking; an external-boundary fake can be appropriate

core/isomorphic-mapping.why: Copies need the same boundary-ownership decision.
core/isomorphic-mapping.risk: An agent can introduce mapping layers without a semantic boundary.
core/isomorphic-mapping.deterministic: none; identical shapes can still represent distinct trust boundaries

core/operations-stay-with-owner.why: Keep orchestration with the model that owns it.
core/operations-stay-with-owner.risk: An agent can spread domain procedures through unrelated entry points.
core/operations-stay-with-owner.deterministic: partial: core/workspace-boundaries checks imports, not operation ownership

core/pinned-suspect-output.why: Suspicious recorded output needs an independent oracle.
core/pinned-suspect-output.risk: An agent can bless NaN or missing-value rendering in a snapshot.
core/pinned-suspect-output.deterministic: none; printing these tokens can itself be the contract

core/precision-boundary-review.why: Unit conversions need domain tolerances and test evidence.
core/precision-boundary-review.risk: An agent can mix units or round at the wrong boundary.
core/precision-boundary-review.deterministic: none; identifier suffixes do not establish units or tolerance

core/property-test-opportunity.why: Review oracle strength and properties together.
core/property-test-opportunity.risk: An agent can cover open transform domains with a few handpicked examples.
core/property-test-opportunity.deterministic: none; lossy transforms do not necessarily obey a round-trip law

core/protected-invariant-change.why: Explicit repository invariants justify human interruption.
core/protected-invariant-change.risk: An agent can change architecture while leaving its governing assumptions stale.
core/protected-invariant-change.deterministic: partial: core/workspace-boundaries enforces declared imports, not general invariants

core/single-use-extraction-review.why: Call count alone cannot price a useful abstraction.
core/single-use-extraction-review.risk: An agent can fragment a procedure into helpers that only add navigation.
core/single-use-extraction-review.deterministic: none; single use and parameter count cannot determine value

core/temporal-coupling.why: Ready-instance construction is a semantic guarantee.
core/temporal-coupling.risk: An agent can expose objects that fail until a separate init call runs.
core/temporal-coupling.deterministic: none; lifecycle state can intentionally be explicit

core/test-behavior-coverage.why: One outcome/oracle review beyond assertion syntax.
core/test-behavior-coverage.risk: An agent can assert interactions or opaque snapshots without proving behavior.
core/test-behavior-coverage.deterministic: partial: core/no-weak-test-assertions and core/no-stubbed-subject; no exact behavioral-oracle coverage

core/test-exercises-project-code.why: A test must reach the real project implementation.
core/test-exercises-project-code.risk: An agent can test copied logic or a dependency while claiming project coverage.
core/test-exercises-project-code.deterministic: none; black-box executables and workspace aliases need context

core/test-expectation-drift.why: Changed expectations need an explicit behavior decision.
core/test-expectation-drift.risk: An agent can make tests green by weakening the oracle alongside a regression.
core/test-expectation-drift.deterministic: none; legitimate behavior changes must change expectations

core/validation-discards-proof.why: A boolean/void validator is not inherently defective.
core/validation-discards-proof.risk: An agent can discard useful refinement, but ordinary predicates are valid APIs.
core/validation-discards-proof.deterministic: none; enforcing a type predicate everywhere is an API preference

effect/layer-identity.why: Fresh Layer identity can duplicate live resources.
effect/layer-identity.risk: An agent can rebuild supposedly shared pools and services per call.
effect/layer-identity.deterministic: partial: effect/no-managed-runtime-per-call; Layer construction has wider identity semantics

effect/prefer-schema-contracts.why: Use domain-scoped schema-domain-types; exports prove no boundary.
effect/prefer-schema-contracts.risk: An agent can trust wire or persisted data through manual types, but helper and capability types need no runtime codec.
effect/prefer-schema-contracts.deterministic: partial: effect/schema-domain-types already enforces domain schema declarations with configurable domain scope and behavior/generic exemptions

effect/resilience-policy.why: Retry/timeout syntax belongs in deterministic checks.
effect/resilience-policy.risk: An agent can retry forever or repeat non-idempotent mutations.
effect/resilience-policy.deterministic: partial: effect/bounded-retry and effect/require-abort-signal; idempotency still requires boundary review

shopify-app/action-label-clarity.why: Review labels in the same merchant workflow.
shopify-app/action-label-clarity.risk: An agent can ship technically labeled buttons whose outcome is unclear.
shopify-app/action-label-clarity.deterministic: partial: shopify-app/s-button-accessible-name and s-clickable-accessible-name check presence, not meaning

shopify-app/admin-api-loop-review.why: GraphQL cost and bulk-operation tradeoffs are domain-specific.
shopify-app/admin-api-loop-review.risk: An agent can exceed Shopify cost budgets through per-item calls.
shopify-app/admin-api-loop-review.deterministic: none; a bounded and rate-controlled loop can be correct

shopify-app/app-ux-review.why: Use explicitly configured routes and browser evidence.
shopify-app/app-ux-review.risk: An agent can pass component lint while leaving a broken merchant workflow.
shopify-app/app-ux-review.deterministic: partial: Shopify component rules cover syntax and accessibility contracts, not interaction fit

shopify-app/banner-usage.why: Review banners once with workflow and dismissal evidence.
shopify-app/banner-usage.risk: An agent can stack irrelevant or nonpersistent operational warnings.
shopify-app/banner-usage.deterministic: none for contextual usefulness or persistence

shopify-app/checkout-network-discipline.why: Checkout latency has a separate user-facing budget.
shopify-app/checkout-network-discipline.risk: An agent can block checkout on an unnecessary remote round trip.
shopify-app/checkout-network-discipline.deterministic: partial: shopify-app/require-fetch-abort-signal checks cancellation, not latency necessity

shopify-app/destructive-action-review.why: Destructive outcomes justify a dedicated review.
shopify-app/destructive-action-review.risk: An agent can expose irreversible actions without consequences or recovery.
shopify-app/destructive-action-review.deterministic: partial: shopify-app/require-idempotent-mutations does not prove confirmation or recovery

shopify-app/flow-action-handler-review.why: Flow delivery and response semantics need handler evidence.
shopify-app/flow-action-handler-review.risk: An agent can process duplicate or unverified deliveries as new work.
shopify-app/flow-action-handler-review.deterministic: partial: shopify-app/require-idempotent-mutations; Flow signatures/status contracts remain

shopify-app/form-error-recovery.why: Recovery feedback is part of the same task flow.
shopify-app/form-error-recovery.risk: An agent can wire an error prop without a usable correction path.
shopify-app/form-error-recovery.deterministic: partial: shopify-app/s-form-control-label-required checks labeling, not error recovery

shopify-app/modal-workflow-review.why: Review modal initiation and dismissal in one workflow.
shopify-app/modal-workflow-review.risk: An agent can implement a modal that traps or interrupts merchants.
shopify-app/modal-workflow-review.deterministic: partial: shopify-app/s-modal-heading-required and s-modal-actions-use-slots check structural contracts

shopify-app/no-pressure-copy.why: Copy intent cannot be decided by a small lexicon.
shopify-app/no-pressure-copy.risk: An agent can add coercive urgency or unsupported guarantees.
shopify-app/no-pressure-copy.deterministic: none; quotation, translation and context determine meaning

shopify-app/review-solicitation.why: Review actual app promotion, not theme/product reviews.
shopify-app/review-solicitation.risk: An agent can add incentivized or badly placed app-rating requests.
shopify-app/review-solicitation.deterministic: none; voluntary wording and placement need merchant context

shopify-app/scope-change-review.why: New access needs a necessity decision.
shopify-app/scope-change-review.risk: An agent can request broader merchant permissions than a feature needs.
shopify-app/scope-change-review.deterministic: partial: conformance-shopify-app/extension-capability-contract validates declarations, not permission necessity

shopify-app/session-token-auth.why: Bind only embedded identity code; drafts are valid storage.
shopify-app/session-token-auth.risk: An agent can confuse browser-persisted identity with authenticated session tokens.
shopify-app/session-token-auth.deterministic: partial: shopify-app/no-session-or-token-logging covers exposure, not authentication ownership

shopify-app/settings-save-bar.why: A form-level marker cannot prove shared save-bar ownership.
shopify-app/settings-save-bar.risk: An agent can leave unsaved changes without contextual save/discard recovery.
shopify-app/settings-save-bar.deterministic: none; save bars may be owned by a surrounding shell

shopify-app/webhook-handler-review.why: Delivery, uninstall and compliance behavior need evidence.
shopify-app/webhook-handler-review.risk: An agent can acknowledge webhooks without safely processing them.
shopify-app/webhook-handler-review.deterministic: partial: shopify-app/webhook-hmac-verification-shape and require-idempotent-mutations check only some obligations

tanstack-query/imperative-query-fetching.why: Disabled queries and refetch effects share lifecycle intent.
tanstack-query/imperative-query-fetching.risk: An agent can bypass query lifecycle through imperative triggers.
tanstack-query/imperative-query-fetching.deterministic: partial: tanstack-query/no-query-data-sync-effect targets state synchronization, not every imperative refetch

tanstack-query/mutation-state-coverage.why: One visible-state review can carry query and mutation modes.
tanstack-query/mutation-state-coverage.risk: An agent can omit pending, failure, retry or duplicate-submit behavior.

tanstack-query/query-freshness-intent.why: Overrides need an explicit freshness policy.
tanstack-query/query-freshness-intent.risk: An agent can disable refetch and retry defaults without considering stale data.
tanstack-query/query-freshness-intent.deterministic: none; immutable data and manual refresh can justify overrides

tanstack-query/query-state-coverage.risk: An agent can render cached data while losing pending, empty or failure states.
tanstack-query/query-state-coverage.deterministic: partial: tanstack-query/query-fn-returns-value and require-fetch-status-check-in-query-fn do not inspect UI behavior

xstate/actor-cleanup.why: Actor lifetime needs an owner and disposal path.
xstate/actor-cleanup.risk: An agent can leak subscriptions, workers or actors after a component leaves.
xstate/actor-cleanup.deterministic: partial: xstate/no-machine-in-render prevents one lifecycle mistake, not general cleanup

xstate/derived-boolean-context.why: Review duplicated state and context truth.
xstate/derived-boolean-context.risk: An agent can let availability booleans diverge from machine state.
xstate/derived-boolean-context.deterministic: none; a boolean may represent independent domain data

xstate/effect-actor-observed.why: An Effect actor's outcome must reach its owner.
xstate/effect-actor-observed.risk: An agent can launch an actor whose failure is never observed.
xstate/effect-actor-observed.deterministic: partial: xstate/no-discarded-effect covers discarded Effects in callbacks, not actor joins

xstate/machine-failure-coverage.risk: An agent can invoke or spawn actors without a usable failure path.
xstate/machine-failure-coverage.deterministic: partial: xstate/no-unreachable-transition does not establish recovery behavior

xstate/persisted-snapshot-compat.why: Bind app persistence; exclude vendored library internals.
xstate/persisted-snapshot-compat.risk: An agent can restore an old machine snapshot into incompatible state definitions.
xstate/persisted-snapshot-compat.deterministic: partial: xstate/no-persist-live-snapshot enforces snapshot kind, not migrations or fallback

xstate/spawn-id-collision.why: Repeated events need deliberate child identity.
xstate/spawn-id-collision.risk: An agent can reuse a child id on the next occurrence of an event.
xstate/spawn-id-collision.deterministic: none; guards or explicit stopping can justify a fixed id

xstate/spawned-actor-release.why: One lifecycle review covers creation, stop and ref release.
xstate/spawned-actor-release.risk: An agent can stop an actor without releasing its retained reference.
